static_traits.name: Li Ming
static_traits.family_status: Has two children，其中一个患有自闭症；养两只狗
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with other parents are affected, feels alienated and hard to connect
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness史；not yet曾接受心理治疗；问题在孩子被诊断为自闭症后开始并逐渐加重
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、思路连贯、配合度Good；语气中性；自我批评与比较倾向明显，偶有Avoids socializing

basic_info.main_problem: 由于一些朋友有更多孩子，我感到自己作为父母not够好，出现Self-doubt并质疑自己的育儿能力。这些感受在孩子被诊断为自闭症后开始并逐渐加重，尤其在与其他家长的社交场合中更为明显。
basic_info.core_demands: 我想更有信心作为父母，停止not断的Self-doubt；希望更好地管理压力，从而更好地陪伴孩子。
growth_experiences: 在孩子被诊断为自闭症之后，Li Ming开始长期感到作为父母的压力与not确定性，觉得需要在两个孩子的not同需求之间艰难平衡。此前并not yet出现类似的心理问题，也not yet接受过心理治疗；No major physical illness史。随着时间推移，问题在与其他家长的比较中加重——尤其在Social gatherings中看到do not人有更多孩子且似乎管理得更好时，Li Ming更倾向于Self-doubt与negate。

special_situations.event: 在与其他家长的Social gatherings上，看到一些朋友有更多孩子且看起来管理得轻松自如
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我have not像他们一样拥有更多孩子并且仍能从容应对，就说明我not够称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 向朋友和网络育儿论坛寻求安慰与认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough/我做得not够

special_situations.event: After the child was diagnosed with autism, daily life requires balancing needs and care between two children
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能同时满足两个孩子的所有需要，就证明我是失败的父母
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 回避与其他家长的社交以降低Self-doubt和压力
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我永远not会像那些父母一样好

special_situations.event: Observes that other parents with more children seem to handle parenting and life better
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 他们的从容意味着我的not称职，这都是我的问题和过错
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not断自我检讨、提高标准，试图弥补所谓not足；持续寻求他人认可
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这都怪I am not good enough

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be recognized as a competent parent, able to steadily care for two children's needs
core_conflict.fear: 害怕在比较中显得not够好、被他人评判为失败，从而影响与孩子及其他家长的关系
defense_goal: 通过寻求外部认可来缓解not安
通过Avoids socializing来减少被比较与被评价的风险、维持安全感

object_relations.object_representation: 更能干且带有评判性的其他家长

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在Social gatherings上看到其他家长似乎从容管理更多孩子，或被询问育儿经验时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将他人的从容视为对自己的negate，认为“I am not good enough”，并把压力与负面评价归因于自身not足（移情：自我批判）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与绝对化表述（如“都是I am not good enough”），降低与他人接触，回避讨论自身的积极面与具体事实；语气沉重、内疚。

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When invited to challenge negative automatic thoughts or try new cognitive frameworks
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Presumes change will be difficult, worries about failing again and being judged, therefore keeps a cautious distance
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Tone is cautious and reserved; expresses concerns (such as 'this is hard') while accepting small attempts but emphasizing risks and difficulty, avoiding overcommitment.

manifestations: 避免与其他家长的社交以减少Self-doubt
在聚会中感到疏离、难以与他人连接
对表达育儿not安全感感到not适，减少自我揭示

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: 频繁自我批评（如“I am not good enough”）
过度比较并担心他人看法
在社交互动中谨慎、Withdrawal，难以真实表达需求

contact_model.definition: The individual ignores or avoids a stimulus from the internal or external environment, deliberately avoiding direct contact.
manifestations: 避免与其他家长直接交流以回避被比较
Turns attention to online forums seeking comfort rather than facing real-life interaction
在聚会中回避深度谈话、Displacement话题

positive_force: 对孩子投入大量时间与精力，有责任感
愿意寻求帮助与接受咨询，表达改变意愿
Has a certain support network (friends to talk about daily challenges with)
negative_force: 依赖外部认可（寻求安慰）但效果有限
在社交场合回避，Reinforcement孤立与Self-doubt
将压力与负面评价内向化，形成自我批判

target_behavior.behavior: 回避与其他父母的社交
antecedent: 在Social gatherings中看到其他家长似乎更能干，或意识到do not人有更多孩子
target_behavior.core_reason: 与他人比较引发自我评判与羞愧，担心被评价为not称职的父母
target_behavior.function: 逃避not受欢迎的情绪（羞愧、Anxiety）与被比较的情境
target_behavior.consequence: Interpersonal alienation、Loneliness感增加，维持并加重Self-doubt与压力

target_behavior.behavior: Excessively seeking external comfort and reassurance (frequently seeking confirmation from friends and online parenting forums)
antecedent: 出现Self-doubt或在比较后感到not安时
target_behavior.core_reason: 将自我价值与外部认可绑定，试图用他人意见降低Anxiety
target_behavior.function: 获得短期的情绪缓解与认可感
target_behavior.consequence: without法形成内在自我评价体系，问题循环持续，Anxiety与Self-doubt并not yet显著缓解

target_behavior.behavior: 自我批评性言语与思维（如“I am not good enough”“我做得not够”）
antecedent: 在两个孩子的需求难以兼顾的情境中
target_behavior.core_reason: negate积极面、过度概括，将单一或局部困难扩展为整体失败
target_behavior.function: Maintains an obsession with control and perfect standards, trying to promote improvement through self-blame
target_behavior.consequence: Anxiety与压力上升，影响与孩子互动及日常生活质量
